sessions.phase_label: Detailed page requirements and visual-design alignment

requirements.title: Master Location-Selection Hub
requirements.definition: The master site must present the national brand and let visitors select a location and continue to the appropriate location website, without owning location booking operations.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers location discovery, selection, and routing from the master site. Static homepage sections, location-site booking capability, and domain assignment are independently testable and excluded.

requirements.title: Reusable Location-Site Template
requirements.definition: Location websites must use a reusable structure that permits future franchise locations to be added without redesigning the overall experience.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers structural reuse and future-location extensibility. Specific Seattle sections, visual branding, and backend-account isolation remain separate.

requirements.title: Location-Site Booking Functionality
requirements.definition: Booking functionality must reside on the applicable location website and support location-specific appointments when that location is open, rather than operating on the master site.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers customer-facing booking capability and its placement on location sites. Segregation of booking records and staff access is handled by operational isolation; payment payouts are separate.

requirements.title: Location Operational Data and Access Isolation
requirements.definition: Each location must independently control and track its bookings, calendar, customer data, analytics, memberships, gift cards, reporting, and staff access.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers per-location segregation of operational state and management access. The existence of booking functionality and separation of payment accounts or payouts have distinct acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Location Payment and Payout Isolation
requirements.definition: Each franchise location must process payments and receive payouts through its own independently controlled payment setup.
requirements.boundary_note: Separate payouts drove the change to separate Wix accounts and sites. It is independent from calendars, reporting, and customer-facing booking functionality.

requirements.title: Seattle Coming-Soon Experience
requirements.definition: Before opening, the Seattle location must operate as a promotional Coming Soon page with appropriate status controls and be prepared for later activation of bookings and updated photography without redesign.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the temporary pre-opening state and activation readiness. The reusable location template and VIP email collection are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Correct Domain-to-Site Assignment
requirements.definition: Each domain must be connected to the correct Wix website and account so the master domain exposes the master experience and location identities remain associated with their proper profiles and settings.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers persistent domain and Wix-profile mapping. It is separate from page-content roles and from the temporary SEO migration strategy because it has its own failure and verification trajectory.

requirements.title: Shared Smash Room Brand Identity
requirements.definition: The master and location sites must consistently use the client's Smash Room identity, supplied logos, established colors, and the confirmed competitor-inspired design direction.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers logos, colors, visual style, national-brand presentation, and cross-site consistency. Responsive behavior and activity-specific image semantics are separate.

unresolved_candidates.description: The history alternates between Seattle and Austin when naming the second Wix site or profile. It is unclear whether Austin is a typo, the account hosting Seattle content, or an additional location, so location-specific event routing requires review.

The complaint about missing packages and booking software does not initially identify a website, and the Seattle requirement previously called for bookings to remain inactive during the Coming Soon phase. Event extraction must resolve whether the failure concerns the master site, Seattle site, another location site, or multiple sites.

The client considers same-domain hosting, domain reassignment, and copying content between Wix profiles while subscriptions and settings are locked to another account. The final technical arrangement beyond the verified domain connection is not fully established.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey! I wanted to send over the vision for the website.

The goal is to build a national brand website for SMASH ROOM that can support multiple locations and future franchise growth.

Main Website:
<http://SMASHROOMUSA.com|SMASHROOMUSA.com>

I want the design to be clean, modern, mobile-friendly, and similar in simplicity to iSmashUSA. Black, purple, and white branding with large images, lots of spacing, and easy navigation.

Homepage Sections:

Hero Banner
Location Selector
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
Reviews
FAQ
Contact

The homepage should immediately show visitors what we offer and allow them to select their location.

Current Locations:

Fairfield, CA
San Francisco, CA
Seattle, WA

I want each location to have its own dedicated page while maintaining the same design and branding across all locations.

The website should be built so future locations can easily be added without redesigning the site.

Future examples:

Phoenix
Denver
Austin
Franchise Locations

The overall feel should be a national entertainment brand, not a local business website.

value_updates.future_location_addition: Future locations must be addable without redesigning the site

I want customers to feel like they are visiting the same SMASH ROOM brand, but the backend operations need to stay completely separate.
